a.speaker: Mira
a.text: You finally made it. The lighthouse has been dark for three nights.

b.speaker: Mira
b.text: Do you want to go up and light it, or check the cellar first?

lamp.speaker: You
lamp.text: The lamp flares to life. Far out at sea, a ship answers with a horn.

cellar.speaker: You
cellar.text: Down below, the old generator hums. Someone has been here recently...

end.speaker: Narrator
